This mod changes all buildings/structures and décor in Pelican Town ( +desert and Ginger Island ).
It doesn't include farm buildings ( see my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4542]Medieval Buildings[/url]﻿ for matching aesthetic ).
It may have some wonky tiles when using with mods that change town map ( like SVE, Reimagined ) as i focused on making it vanilla-ready first. I'll make sure they all work perfectly in the future updates c:

[color=#e06666]SMAPI, Content Patcher nedeed![/color]
1. Download 
2. Unzip/extract
3. Paste into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder
4. Run the game once to generate config.json
5. Edit config.json to your liking
